children: Lesaka Technologies reported fiscal 2026 full-year results showing a return to GAAP profitability and stronger non-GAAP performance. For FY2026 Lesaka posted revenue of $721.6 million, Net Revenue of $374.9 million and Group Adjusted EBITDA of $75.7 million, and reported Adjusted earnings per share of $0.39. Management said the company met FY2026 guidance, exceeded Adjusted EPS guidance and outlined medium‑term ambitions including >40% Adjusted EPS CAGR over the next three years.
Operating income (FY2026): $12,681 thousand versus a loss of $(27,966) thousand in FY2025.
Net income attributable to Lesaka (FY2026): $2,758 thousand versus a loss of $(90,957) thousand in FY2025.
Group Adjusted EBITDA (FY2026): $75,742 thousand (FY2025: $49,822 thousand); Adjusted earnings (FY2026): $32,232 thousand; Adjusted EPS (FY2026): $0.39.
Segment performance: Merchant revenue declined year‑on‑year, while Consumer and Enterprise segments recorded strong growth — Consumer revenue +38% and Enterprise revenue +62% in FY2026 versus FY2025.
Net Revenue mix shift: Net Revenue growth of 20% year‑on‑year to $374.9M reflects higher contribution from distribution/agent vs. inventory mix adjustments emphasized by the company.
Operational actions: Company undertook a Lesaka brand refresh launched in November 2025 and incurred related one‑off rebrand costs during FY2026 as part of a "One Lesaka" consolidation.

Strategic activity and outlook: FY2027 guidance incorporates the pending Bank Zero acquisition (subject to approvals) and includes Net Revenue, Group Adjusted EBITDA and Adjusted EPS targets expressed in ZAR; management flagged expected Q1 FY2027 merchant restructuring costs and medium‑term ambition for strong EPS growth.
